source_structure.kernel: Exact five original statements translated into task-local syntax; Lean proves environment lowering, interpreted execution and an independent closed address/scalar plan.
host_order: pointer extraction and runtime i32 packing
source_structure.zero: Allocation happens first; sqrt0 and ceil0 and next_power_of_2(0)=0, then cdiv(0,0) raises. No empty-return claim.
source_structure.device: No CUDA assertion, no explicit wrapper device context, no same-device requirement. Current launch-device permissions are separate from tensor owner metadata.
source_structure.type_first_rejection: Five binder rejects; two fnuz architecture rejects before body; admitted types reject BLOCK>=2^31 before arange and 2^20<BLOCK<2^31 at tensor shape. Ordinary JIT/compile/context/packing/launch errors explicit.
source_structure.grid_parser: Infrastructure signed-grid parser rejects overflow before pointer extraction. Large cosine blocks reject compilation first; the add-value N=2^41 counterexample is not reused as a reachable cosine source case.
source_structure.scalar: Actual one loaded raw word, explicit cast to fp32 for every admitted dtype including fp64, math.cos/libdevice __nv_cosf, then exact typed store route; bool load is raw i8 nonzero and bool store is signed-i8 raw; no second pointer or ghost value.
source_structure.integer_store: Partial FP.IntegerConversion domain; undefined conversions are mathematical observations before materialization, with no native trap/final-memory claim.
source_structure.two31: N=2^31 gives block65536/grid32768, bound narrows to signed i32 negative and every mask is false; successful setup returns the allocated tensor and unchanged memory.

memory_trust.mandatory_laws: WordMemory supplies exact little-endian raw-word load/store with byte presence and congruence/disjoint/frame laws. Arbitrary-carrier readback alone is insufficient.
memory_trust.metadata: Actual shape/numel/storage offset/preserve-format strides/fresh output; Torch storage base, Torch data pointer and extracted kernel pointer distinct. On successful packing use the actual extracted pointer and mapped allocation. Unused total fields on unentered/failed extraction may carry affine witnesses without asserting extraction success.
memory_trust.execution: Every complete program schedule permutation; finite wrapping i32 offset/signed mask and sign-extended wrapping u64 pointer; all actual requests, access permissions, byte presence and ownership checked.
memory_trust.specification: Independent initial-memory byte formula and complete exterior frame, with no master access/value/no-wrap precondition. Observations assert no native trap, race winner, rollback or postfailure memory.

host_numerical_trust.pure_model: Nearest-even quotient for int-to-binary64, exact scaled integer sqrt and squared-midpoint rounding, represented-value ceil, installed six shifts. No callback that supplies host results and no replacement by real sqrt.
host_numerical_trust.native_correspondence: Explicitly unvalidated. Register HostMath.integer64 and HostMath.sqrtSignificand concrete native-conformance ports on all246 post-allocation scope cases, including N0 and later binder/architecture/block/setup failures. No host ports on22 allocation failures.
host_numerical_trust.environment: Exact CPython/runtime/math-extension hashes and sampled current FE_TONEAREST=0; changed fenv requires new native correspondence. Correctly-rounded native sqrt is an obligation, not a proved premise.
host_numerical_trust.sampling: 210943 native comparisons include all32 observed thresholds, but are nonexhaustive and do not prove signed64 native conformance.
